objective: Resolve verified legacy BUKLOD Quiz email/UUID conflicts safely while preserving existing Quiz exams, attempts, roster and grades
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: 2026-10-31 Quiz dedicated Supabase cjtehbfspgimyhifnjon ACTIVE_HEALTHY, Edge buklod-quiz-main-entry-v1 live version 10 source read, ensure-main-shadow-user SQL read, 2 distinct verified email UUID conflicts (one with attempt and roster), function_logs email_identity_conflict through 05:22 UTC; GitHub main f773f44a inspected. No production behavior acceptance yet.
chosenApproach: Use a service-only RPC to resolve existing verified Quiz UUIDs by email, then recheck live Main email ownership in Edge Auth, bind Main ID in Quiz app_metadata, preserve Quiz profile role and issue existing one-time sign-in.
selectionRationale: Smallest non-destructive bridge fix; unlike forcing Quiz UUID to Main UUID it does not migrate foreign keys or disturb attempts, session records, exams or grades. Validated Main email live only in the legacy collision path.
alternativeApproaches: Change existing Quiz user UUID to Main UUID and cascade references: rejected as dangerous to exams and sessions
Create a second shadow Quiz user with synthetic email: rejected because existing attempts and roster would appear missing
Use full Quiz user listing on every bridge login: rejected as unscalable for 1M users
preserveBehaviors: Main UUID remains authoritative in Main
Quiz UUID remains authoritative inside Quiz for existing records
Existing Quiz role and privileges preserved
Quiz main getClaims fast path retained
Quiz one-time handoff URL and session_launch_ready flag unchanged
No Main DB, APK or OTA modification
acceptanceChecks: Scoped diff matches exactly five paths
Focused Node source contract and read-only SQL behavioral tests pass

No Quiz record/user deletion and no Main DB change
